title: The scattered archive

stages.text: Find Tamar. Her scriptorium has the gold door, just north of here.
Walk into the tall reeds east along the path and capture the word hiding there.
Go back to Tamar's scriptorium. She has one more lesson for you.
Capture three words in the reeds. Tamar says the stream crossing will test you after that.
Answer Neri's challenge on the bridge north of the path.
Read the riddle stone, then choose the right door in the Field Gate.
Enter the Hall of Letters and take Ilana's trial for the Reed Seal.
Carry the Reed Seal to the arch at the north end of the grove.

reward: The road to the Vowel Springs unseals.
